description: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “per-specialty terms” across six specialty categories, with multiple colored bars in each category indicating models “Fine-tuned on” different specialties as shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categories Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics in that left-to-right order, labeled “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick labels from approximately −27 up to −22 at regular 1-unit intervals. For each x-axis category, there is a cluster of six narrow vertical bars colored from very light beige through progressively darker orange/brown tones corresponding to the legend entries (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics); the bars extend downward from near −22 to their values. In the Cardio category, the six bars range roughly from about −25.7 to −26.1, with one additional light blue bar at about −26.8. In Gastro, the specialty-colored bars are around −23.8 to −24.2, with a light blue bar near −24.9. In Infect, the specialty-colored bars are near −22.9 to −23.3, with a light blue bar around −23.7. In Neuro, the specialty-colored bars are around −24.2 to −24.7, with a light blue bar near −25.4. In Obstetrics, the specialty-colored bars are around −23.7 to −24.1, with a light blue bar near −24.8. In Pediatrics, the specialty-colored bars are around −23.5 to −24.0, with a light blue bar near −24.8. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), there is no visible sorting by bar height within groups, and no bars appear specially outlined or annotated beyond the legend and axis labels.
